articles.summary: SARASOTA, Fla., May 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Roper Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROP) announced that its Board of Directors has approved a dividend of $0.91 per share payable on July 22, 2026, to stockholders of record on July 8, 2026. articles.title: Roper Technologies announces dividend
